### The Call to Sound Doctrine
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/call-to-sound-doctrine
Passage: Titus 2:1
Points:
- Paul charges Titus to combat cultural corruption by proclaiming instruction that nourishes and sustains souls.
- Sound doctrine encompasses both orthodox theology and practical moral duties across Christian life.
- Right ethical living requires knowing what is holy, while active obedience deepens understanding of God's truth.
- Believers must deliberately pursue both sound doctrinal understanding and concrete, daily obedience.

### Sensible Men
Author: Grace to You
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B150723/sensible-men
Passage: Titus 2:6-8
Points:
- Younger men are called to practice self-control, good judgment, and restraint in every aspect of life.
- Leaders and young believers must set an example of genuine good works and moral purity that match biblical truth.
- Everyday conversation and formal instruction alike should remain wholesome, dignified, and beyond reproach.
- Living with visible integrity removes ammunition from opponents and makes the gospel believable before the world.
